name: DeepSieve
tagline: Deep research that returns a sourced dataset, re-verified on your schedule
description: DeepSieve turns a question into a structured dataset: you approve the schema, it researches the public web, and monitored reports are re-verified on your schedule with change history. A second, independent AI scores each finding so you get to set the trust bar. Connect over remote MCP with OAuth sign-in.

install.notes: Sign in with your DeepSieve account in the browser when prompted. No API key needed.
